annotation_mean_bounds.scope: answer-column means over every set between the annotation-derived lower and upper; stored rule verdicts and column universe fixed

external_subset_input.selection_scope: supplied membership; this tool does not validate its semantic labels

limits: Stored demand annotations are not independent expert validation; membership does not guarantee every requested field/value is scored.
All row-set rules ignore row ranking, order, ties and duplicate-row multiplicity. Nested values retain the existing normalization.
C uses the gold as an alignment oracle and is a sensitivity measure, not a deployable prediction method.
C=S and matching clear-model counts, if observed, are dataset findings rather than universal correctness invariants.
CI resamples items, assumes that unit is appropriate, and applies no cluster-dependence or family-wise correction.
Best-text reselection is over the original 18 arms; no retained per-item rebuilt retrieval outputs are available here.
Missing predictions and failed/missing query replays score zero over the whole selected population.

metric_definitions.answer_column: normalized value-set F1 against the declared Core answer-column key
metric_definitions.declared_type_S/P/C: full_record rule for declared tuple_set/mapping items; answer_column for all other declared types
metric_definitions.full_record_C: gold-oracle maximum set overlap with one common column permutation per model/item; C=P if widths differ
metric_definitions.full_record_P: set of normalized row tuples in RETURN column positions; no column-name matching
metric_definitions.full_record_S: set of rows; each row is the sorted tuple of normalized values, ignoring column roles
metric_definitions.point_gap: minimum_point_gap_to_best_text uses unrounded means; minimum_point_gap_from_rounded_means subtracts six-decimal means
metric_definitions.pooled: unweighted average across model/item pairs; pooled_from_rounded_model_means also reports rounded-model aggregation
metric_definitions.rank: same scorer versus Core; full_record model means rounded to six decimals before ranking; average ties
metric_definitions.text: answer-column scoring of the original closed_book/rag logs; not rebuilt retrieval

bootstrap.clear_rule: rounded lower > 0; below iff rounded upper < 0
bootstrap.unit: item; common draw across models, scorers and text arms

selection.bound_scope: stored column universe, rule verdicts and other flags fixed; language-model column/phrase judgments varied

later_required_column_all_released.definition: at least one column after index 0 has a recorded required verdict; does not assert that the scored first column is wrong
